title: Acquire and Register Land Title in Ghana
description: The legal sequential roadmap to verify ownership, survey boundaries, assess stamp duties, and obtain an official Land Title Certificate from the Lands Commission.

consultant.name: Babanawo Consults
consultant.specialty: Ghana Real Estate & Land Title Due Diligence

steps.title: Conduct Consolidated Search at Lands Commission
steps.why: Verifies true ownership, confirms whether the parcel is state land, stool land, or family land, and ensures there are no conflicting registrations or mortgages.
steps.do_this_when: Before making any financial commitment or signing purchase agreements with landowners.

options.label: Lands Commission Consolidated Search Request
options.notes: Official search application portal across Land Registration, Survey & Mapping, and Public & Vested Lands Divisions.

steps.title: Cadastral Survey & Site Plan Approval
steps.why: A licensed surveyor must demarcate the exact GPS boundaries and have the site plan formally countersigned and approved by the Regional Director of Surveys.
steps.do_this_when: Immediately following search clearance and execution of the indenture/lease agreement.

options.label: Lands Commission Site Plan and Survey Approval
options.notes: Submission for cadastral site plan examination and official barcode issuance.

steps.title: Stamp Duty Assessment & Payment at GRA
steps.why: Under the Stamp Duty Act 2005 (Act 689), deeds of conveyance or leases must be assessed and stamped to be legally admissible in Ghanaian courts and registries.
steps.do_this_when: After the site plan is approved and signed by both parties.

options.label: GRA Stamp Duty Assessment Portal
options.notes: Valuation and assessment guidelines on land conveyance instruments.

steps.title: Register Deed at Lands Commission
steps.why: Records the stamped conveyance in the Deeds Registry to establish legal notice and priority of claim.
steps.do_this_when: Following payment and affixing of the GRA stamp duty endorsement.

options.label: Lands Commission Deed Registration Portal
options.notes: Official deed submission desk with stamp duty verification.

steps.title: Apply for Land Title Certificate (Registration Districts)
steps.why: In declared title registration districts (such as Greater Accra and parts of Ashanti Region), obtaining a Land Title Certificate grants an indefeasible, state-guaranteed title.
steps.do_this_when: After deed recording, subject to statutory 21-day public newspaper notice.

options.label: Land Title Registration Services
options.notes: Application for Yellow Card title certification and publication.

steps.title: Secure District Assembly Building Permit
steps.why: The Local Governance Act mandates obtaining building permit approval before breaking ground or undertaking any civil construction.
steps.do_this_when: Prior to any physical construction or groundbreaking on the parcel.

options.label: Accra Metropolitan Assembly Building Permit Guidelines
options.notes: Development permitting checklist for architectural, structural, and EPA approval.
